VF01 named both under KNOWN_PREFILLS and its repair note asked for item 1 to be taken 'from the same screening record that supplied 2019-004217-FY to the caption'. This lane did not do that and says so plainly: the fixtures hold matter.case_number and matter.county and hold no crime, no charge code and no conviction date, the form's own instruction 4 directs the applicant to get the exact date and charge FROM THE COURT and to attach a certified copy of each conviction, and there is no held record in this worktree to take them from. whatIsWrittenNow.whyNineAndNotTheLadderDefault: The box's printed caption is drawn inside the top of its own widget rectangle and the CTN/TCN rule closes it at the foot, leaving about 39pt of clear height. Left on the family ceiling of 11 the fitter lands the boundary block on 9.5pt, whose fourth line draws the parenthesis descenders of the telephone number across that printed rule — measured on a 600 dpi local raster of a probe render. 9pt is the largest size whose lowest ink clears the rule, and it is declared as this field's ceiling for that reason rather than chosen.

howItIsWritten.whyANewChannelWasNeeded: decideBinding binds ONE descriptor to one field and the shared registry has no composed contact descriptor. On this caption the address descriptor matches, so the only outcomes reachable before were to write the street address alone — a third of the answer in the box the court reads for contact details — or to write nothing. That was measured, not assumed: the first build after the repair, before the composed pass was routed around the single-fact channel, drew exactly the street address and nothing else.
howItIsWritten.noCallerTextReachesThePage: The option takes FACT IDS, not text. The finalizer resolves each id against the same facts set every other write is resolved from and joins them with newlines. A named fact that is absent, empty or not a string refuses the whole box rather than composing a partial one, so a sentence, a caption or an invented value cannot be passed through it.
howItIsWritten.sameGatesAsAnyOtherWrite: role gate, protectCategoryOf on both the label and the field name, text-field type guard, the form's own maxLength, and the shared fitter against the widget's own geometry.

appearanceProof.apostropheCorrection: This family's build-findings previously recorded, as an advisory, that the boundary participant's typographic apostrophe (U+2019) does not survive into the finalized bytes. That was a reading error, not a defect: the finalizer encodes it as WinAnsi 0x92 and the read-back decoded the appearance as Latin-1, which turns 0x92 into an invisible control character. The read-back now translates the WinAnsi 0x80-0x9F block, the apostrophe is present in the bytes and legible at 300 dpi, and the finding is corrected in build-findings.json.
